scenario: Every Monday, pull all open Salesforce opportunities, total amount and count by stage and owner, and post the summary table to the #sales-leadership Slack channel.
rule_hooks: stage list and ordering, open-stage definition

scenario: On Thursday before the forecast call, sum each rep's Commit and Best Case opportunities closing this quarter from HubSpot and append a row per rep to the Forecast Google Sheet, flagging reps whose commit is below 70% of quota.
At month end, total Closed Won amount per rep from Salesforce against the quota tab in Google Sheets, rank reps by attainment percentage, and email the leaderboard to the VP of Sales.
Each Wednesday, find open opportunities with no activity in 21+ days, count them per owner, and DM each sales manager a list of their team's stale deals with total at-risk value.
On the first of the month, count last month's HubSpot leads by source and how many converted to opportunities, compute conversion rates, and write the results to the Marketing Attribution sheet.
Daily, measure time from lead creation to first logged call or email for yesterday's inbound leads, compute the median per SDR, and post SLA breaches to #sdr-team.
At quarter end, aggregate Closed Lost opportunities by loss reason and competitor, with counts and lost value, and publish the breakdown as a Google Doc shared with product marketing.
Monthly, compute win rate (won ÷ won+lost) by customer segment and region for deals closed in the trailing 90 days, and update the Win Rates tab in the RevOps dashboard sheet.
rule_hooks: segment by employee count, region territory map

scenario: Each morning, list Salesforce CPQ quotes pending discount approval, compute days waiting per approver, and post approvals older than two business days to #deal-desk.
rule_hooks: approval matrix by discount tier, aging threshold

scenario: Monthly, compare quoted line-item prices on closed-won quotes against the price book, total discount dollars per rep and product, and email the deal desk lead a variance report.
rule_hooks: price book list prices, discount guardrails

scenario: Every Friday, pull DocuSign envelopes sent but not completed, match them to Salesforce opportunities, total contract value awaiting signature, and post the list to #sales-ops.
On the 1st of each month, find customer contracts expiring in the next 90 days in Salesforce, total ARR up for renewal per account manager, and add a row per account to the Renewals Tracker sheet.
rule_hooks: renewal window, ARR field, AM ownership

scenario: At month close, sum starting ARR, expansion, contraction and churn from QuickBooks invoices and CRM account data, compute NRR and GRR, and publish the figures in the monthly board metrics Google Doc.
rule_hooks: NRR formula, churn vs contraction definition

scenario: Every Friday, count first meetings booked by each SDR this week from Google Calendar invites tagged 'Discovery', compare to weekly targets, and post the scorecard to #sdr-team.
rule_hooks: meeting naming convention, SDR weekly target

scenario: Weekly, compare scheduled Zoom demo meetings with actual Zoom attendance records, compute no-show rate per AE and lead source, and email the report to the sales enablement manager.
Each Monday, count HubSpot contacts and companies missing required fields (industry, phone, owner, lifecycle stage) per owner and post a hygiene scorecard to #revops.
Monthly, scan Salesforce accounts for probable duplicates by normalized domain and name, count clusters per territory, and write the cluster list to a RevOps cleanup sheet.
At the start of each quarter week, divide each team's open next-quarter pipeline by its quota target, flag teams below 3x coverage, and post the ratios to #sales-leadership.
rule_hooks: coverage target multiple, team quota targets

scenario: After quarter close, compare each rep's week-8 submitted forecast in the Forecast sheet with actual closed-won bookings, compute variance and accuracy percentage, and email the summary to the CRO.
Every Monday, compare this week's opportunity snapshot to last week's to total new, advanced, slipped, won and lost pipeline dollars, and append the waterfall to the Pipeline History sheet.
Weekly, find opportunities whose close date moved out of the current quarter in the last 7 days using field history, sum slipped value per rep, and DM each manager their team's slippage.
rule_hooks: fiscal quarter calendar, field history tracking

scenario: Monthly, compute average days spent in each opportunity stage for deals closed last quarter, compare to the prior quarter, and publish the stage-duration table in Notion for sales enablement.
rule_hooks: stage history, benchmark days per stage

scenario: Every Friday, count calls, emails, and meetings logged per AE in Salesforce this week, compare to activity minimums, and post the scorecard to the sales managers' Slack channel.
Each Monday, pull the ten largest open opportunities closing this quarter, summarize stage, next step and last activity, and email the brief to the executive team.
At month end, match Closed Won opportunities to Xero invoices by account and amount, total bookings not yet invoiced, and send the variance list to finance and sales ops.
On the 3rd of each month, total last month's closed-won amounts per rep by product line, apply commission rates from the comp plan sheet, and write accrual rows to the Commissions sheet for payroll.
Quarterly, count target-account-list companies per territory with no open opportunity or activity in 6 months, and share the whitespace list with each regional manager via email.
rule_hooks: ICP target list, territory assignment rules

scenario: Weekly, count HubSpot contacts moving MQL→SQL→Opportunity this week by campaign, compute stage-to-stage conversion, and post the funnel to #marketing-sales-sync.
Every morning, count leads assigned more than 48 hours ago still in 'New' status per SDR and post a backlog table to #sdr-team with the oldest lead for each rep.
rule_hooks: lead status values, backlog age threshold

scenario: Monthly, total upsell and cross-sell opportunities created per account manager and product, alongside current seat usage from the product usage sheet, and publish a summary to the CS-sales Slack channel.
Weekly, for renewals due in 60 days, count open high-priority Zendesk tickets per account, flag accounts above threshold, and email the at-risk list to the account managers and CS lead.
At month end, sum opportunities by partner-referral field and partner tier from Salesforce, compute partner-sourced share of total pipeline, and update the Partner Program sheet.
rule_hooks: partner tier list, source attribution rules

scenario: Monthly, compute average and median closed-won deal size by product and segment for the last 6 months and post the trend table to #revops with month-over-month change.
Quarterly, count signed DocuSign contracts by term length and billing frequency, total ACV for each mix, and publish the summary to a finance-shared Google Doc.
Two weeks after a trade show, count leads tagged with the event campaign, how many were contacted and how many have meetings, and email the event ROI summary to the field marketing manager.
Quarterly, compute median days from opportunity creation to close for won deals by deal size band and lead source, and add the results to the RevOps quarterly review deck notes in Google Docs.
rule_hooks: deal size bands, cycle start definition

scenario: Every Tuesday, pull overdue invoices from QuickBooks, group by customer and the CRM account owner, total amounts per aging bucket, and DM each owner their overdue accounts for collection outreach.
On the 2nd of each month, count first-time closed-won accounts last month by region and segment, compare to the new-logo target, and post the result to #company-wins.
Weekly, count open opportunities with each competitor in the Competitor field plus their combined pipeline value and win rate, and update the Competitive Intel sheet tab.

Two days before a scheduled customer QBR on the calendar, gather the account's ARR, open opportunities, renewal date, and open Freshdesk tickets, and post a one-page summary to the account's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: QBR calendar tag, account field mapping

scenario: Every Monday, read last month's first meetings from the shared sales calendar, match each external attendee's domain to a CRM account, count how many produced a new opportunity within 14 days, and post conversion rates by AE to the #sales-leadership Slack channel.

Each week, list open Salesforce opportunities over $50k in Proposal stage or later that have fewer than three contact roles or no economic buyer tagged, and email each regional manager a count and list for their team.

On the 1st and 15th, audit opportunities in Stage 3 or later for required MEDDICC fields (metrics, decision process, champion), then write the percentage compliant per rep to a Google Sheet tab and post the five worst gaps in Slack.
Monthly, pull quotes created in HubSpot that use a non-standard or legacy price book, total their value by approver, and post the summary to the deal desk channel.
rule_hooks: approved price book list, approver mapping

scenario: Every Friday, read the contract-review tracker sheet and DocuSign envelope histories, compute median days from redline request to legal sign-off by contract type (MSA, DPA, order form), and email the report to the GC and VP Sales.

Each Monday, list free trials that ended in the prior week, join product usage from the trials sheet with the CRM opportunity status, and post converted, extended, and lapsed counts plus conversion rate by trial source.
rule_hooks: trial-end date window, usage activation threshold

scenario: Quarterly, compare each customer account's ARR and employee count against the tiering rubric, count the accounts whose CRM tier field disagrees with the rubric, and post the list by account owner to RevOps.

Biweekly, for reps hired in the last six months, compare pipeline created and bookings to date against their month-by-month ramp quota from the enablement sheet, and email each manager an on-track or behind status per rep.
rule_hooks: ramp quota schedule by tenure month

scenario: Weekly, check newly assigned inbound leads against the round-robin and territory routing rules sheet, count the misrouted leads per queue, and post the totals and a sample to the #revops Slack channel.

Monthly, tally reference-call requests logged in the reference request form sheet per reference account, flag accounts that exceed the quarterly cap, and post usage counts to the customer marketing channel.
Every Tuesday, read the RFP intake sheet and linked CRM opportunities, count the RFPs due in the next 30 days by owner, compute year-to-date RFP win rate, and post the digest to #proposals.

When the quarter closes, read closed-won multi-year deals with ramped pricing, break out contracted ARR by fiscal year into the FP&A bookings schedule sheet, and email the finance lead the per-year totals.
rule_hooks: fiscal calendar, ramp schedule line items

scenario: Monthly, collect accounts whose subscriptions were cancelled in the accounting app, join with the CRM churn reason and ARR lost, rank the reasons by dollars, and post the summary to the customer success and sales leadership channels.
rule_hooks: churn reason picklist, ARR source of truth

scenario: Each month, compare renewal opportunities closed-won against prior-year contract value, count the renewals below the standard 7% uplift without an approved exception, and email the list to the CRO.
rule_hooks: standard uplift percentage, exception approval records

scenario: On the 5th of each month, compare active seat counts from the product usage export with contracted seats in the CRM, list the accounts over 110% of their contracted seats with the overage value, and send each account manager their accounts.
rule_hooks: overage tolerance percentage, list price per seat

scenario: Weekly, count deal desk tickets in the helpdesk by request type (non-standard terms, pricing, billing) and median time-to-resolution, then post the summary against the 2-business-day SLA in #deal-desk.
Every Monday, read SDR-sourced opportunities created last week, count the ones AEs accepted, rejected, or left untouched for more than 3 days, and post acceptance rates by SDR-AE pair.

Daily, list partner deal registrations pending approval in the CRM, bucket them by age (0-2, 3-5, 5+ days), and post counts to the channel team with any that have breached the 5-day approval commitment.

At quarter end, attribute closed-won revenue to marketing campaigns with a touch in the 90 days before opportunity creation, total the influenced revenue per campaign, and write the results to the marketing ROI sheet.

Weekly, for accounts on the ABM target list sheet, count meetings, email replies, and web visits from HubSpot, classify each as cold, warming, or engaged, and post the tier counts and new 'engaged' accounts to Slack.
rule_hooks: engagement scoring thresholds, target account list

scenario: Monthly, find closed-won deals whose order forms carry payment terms longer than Net 30 or quarterly-in-arrears billing, total their ACV by rep, and email the report to the controller and sales ops.

At month close, split closed-won opportunity line items by product family (core platform, add-ons, services), compute each family's share of bookings versus the plan mix, and post the variance table to #revenue.
rule_hooks: product family mapping, planned mix percentages

scenario: Quarterly, among new logos signed in the quarter, count how many bought the Analytics add-on at signing, report the attach rate by segment and AE, and write it to the product marketing dashboard sheet.

Weekly, read the CRM field history for opportunity owner changes, count reassignments by from/to rep and reason, highlight those changed within 14 days of close, and email the audit to the comp admin.
Every other Monday, pull email outreach sequence stats from HubSpot, compute reply and meeting-booked rates per sequence and per step, and post the top and bottom three sequences to the SDR channel.

Weekly, measure the days between closed-won and the onboarding kickoff meeting appearing on the calendar for each new customer, and post the average plus any deals exceeding 10 days to the sales and CS leads.
rule_hooks: handoff SLA days, kickoff meeting naming convention

scenario: Daily during the last two weeks of the quarter, compare each closed-won opportunity amount with the total on its completed DocuSign order form, and post a count and list of mismatches over $500 to RevOps.
rule_hooks: amount tolerance, signed document as source of truth

scenario: During the final 15 days of the quarter, list commit-category opportunities at accounts flagged 'PO required' that have no PO number recorded, total the at-risk amount by region, and post it to #forecast.

Every Wednesday, count open security questionnaires and vendor assessments in the helpdesk queue linked to open opportunities, sum the pipeline value they block, and post the list by due date to the security and sales channels.
Daily during the Q4 multi-year SPIFF, total qualifying closed-won multi-year deals per rep, rank them against the contest payout tiers, and update the pinned standings message in #sales.

Monthly, read the enrichment export of contacts whose employer changed, match them to CRM champion contacts on customer and open-opportunity accounts, and send each account owner a count and list of departed champions.
rule_hooks: champion contact role, account status filter

scenario: At the start of each quarter, check the Drive account-plan folder for a current plan for every Tier 1 account, count the missing or outdated plans per owner, and email managers the completion percentage.
rule_hooks: Tier 1 account list, plan freshness window

scenario: Weekly, compare external-attendee meetings on each AE's calendar with meetings logged in the CRM activity history, compute the percentage logged per rep, and post the scorecard to sales managers.
rule_hooks: internal vs external domain list, logging policy

scenario: Every Thursday, read active proof-of-concept records from the project tool, count them by status against their success-criteria deadlines, sum the associated pipeline, and post the rollup to the solutions engineering channel.
rule_hooks: POC duration limit, success criteria dates

scenario: Every Monday, read customer contracts with auto-renew clauses, list those whose cancellation notice deadline falls in the next 45 days, and email each account manager their accounts with the notice dates and ARR.
At month close, convert closed-won bookings in EUR, GBP, and AUD to USD using the fixed plan FX rates sheet, total by region, and post both local-currency and USD totals to the finance channel.
rule_hooks: plan FX rate table, regional mapping

scenario: After each quarterly NPS survey, match detractor responses (score 0-6) to CRM accounts, count detractors and ARR at risk per account owner, and post the summary to account management with each owner's list.
Before annual planning, total accounts, customer ARR, and open pipeline per AE book, compute each book's deviation from the team average, and write the balance table to the territory planning sheet.
Daily, list sent quotes that expire in the next 7 days without an accepted or signed status, total the value by rep, and send each rep a Slack DM with their expiring quotes.
rule_hooks: quote validity period, quote status values

scenario: Quarterly, rank customers by ARR from the billing system, compute the share of total ARR held by the top 10 and top 25 accounts, and post the concentration figures with quarter-over-quarter change to the exec team.
